lines.text: Paul asks whether believers should continue in sin so grace may increase, and he answers that those who died to sin cannot live in it.
All who were baptized into Christ Jesus were buried with Him into death, so that we too may walk by the Spirit.
Our old self was crucified with Christ so that we should no longer be slaves to sin, since anyone who has died is freed from sin.
Christ was raised from the dead and cannot die again; He died to sin seven times, but He lives to God.
Believers must count themselves dead to sin and alive to God, because sin shall not be their master, since they are under grace.
